MOCK_THOUGHT.title: Mock Thought
MOCK_THOUGHT.description: Gain 3 Energy at the start of combat
PURE_WHITE_PETALS.title: Pure White Petals
PURE_WHITE_PETALS.description: Interpret with Wordless Deed to gain Tower of Babel's Oath
WORDLESS_DEED.title: Wordless Deed
WORDLESS_DEED.description: Interpret with Pure White Petals to gain Tower of Babel's Oath
DAYBREAK_SUN.title: Daybreak Sun
DAYBREAK_SUN.description: When entering a new Act with this Lingerer, increase its rarity by 1. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
DAYBREAK_SUN.flavor: If one must always leave early and return late, there is no time left to admire the sun.
WILD_GRASS_BY_THE_DOOR.title: Wild Grass by the Door
WILD_GRASS_BY_THE_DOOR.description: When entering a new Act with this Lingerer, reroll its rarity. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
WILD_GRASS_BY_THE_DOOR.flavor: They say I'm like a blade of grass. I want to see what grass looks like.
MEMORIAL_STONES.title: Memorial Stones
MEMORIAL_STONES.description: When entering a new Act with this Lingerer, increase its rarity by 2. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
MEMORIAL_STONES.flavor: I should have climbed that tower, but I fell at its feet.
NEMESIS_BLOOD.title: Nemesis Blood
NEMESIS_BLOOD.description: When entering a new Act with this Lingerer, reduce its Toil by 1. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
NEMESIS_BLOOD.flavor: Not because I hate him, but because he deserves to die.
HOMES_DUST.title: Homes Dust
HOMES_DUST.description: After losing this, it returns to your hand when entering a new Act. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
HOMES_DUST.flavor: What did these two words originally mean? Which one is 'home'?
SHRIVEL_AND_SPROUT.title: Shrivel and Sprout
SHRIVEL_AND_SPROUT.description: When entering the next Act with this Lingerer, gain this Lingerer again. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
SHRIVEL_AND_SPROUT.flavor: You're only telling me now that I have a child?
LEAD_TAG.title: Lead Tag
LEAD_TAG.description: After losing this, gain 30 Gold. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
LEAD_TAG.flavor: Knock on the door. If the person inside is willing to open it, tell them I'm gone.
CHEERFUL_BANTER.title: Cheerful Banter
CHEERFUL_BANTER.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
CHEERFUL_BANTER.flavor: Cheer up. Your debt to me is canceled now.
POTS_IN_THE_GROUND.title: Pots in the Ground
POTS_IN_THE_GROUND.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
POTS_IN_THE_GROUND.flavor: After what happened to me, I wonder what they'll eat. Sigh.
WALLED_GOLD.title: Walled Gold
WALLED_GOLD.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
WALLED_GOLD.flavor: I only hope they're clever enough not to trade my gold for those scraps of paper.
STORED_INSTRUMENTS.title: Stored Instruments
STORED_INSTRUMENTS.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
STORED_INSTRUMENTS.flavor: Never mind. Our ancestors are watching over them. They can't go too far astray.
EMPTY_THOUGHTS.title: Empty Thoughts
EMPTY_THOUGHTS.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
NONSENSICAL_RAVINGS.title: Nonsensical Ravings
NONSENSICAL_RAVINGS.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
SPEECHLESS.title: Speechless
SPEECHLESS.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
SPROUTING_STEM.title: Sprouting Stem
SPROUTING_STEM.description: A Common Wish. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
SPROUTING_STEM.flavor: The gun is too heavy. I can't carry it anymore. Take it, but remember to remove the barrel.
KNOTTED_ROPE.title: Knotted Rope
KNOTTED_ROPE.description: With this Lingerer, Eras appear more frequently. More likely to gain Relics when interpreting
KNOTTED_ROPE.flavor: Pull it across, and it's a new year. Too bad I won't see it.
ELDERS_CROWN.title: Elders Crown
ELDERS_CROWN.description: Can be decoded with an Inspirer into a higher-rarity Inspirer. Otherwise, more likely to gain Relics when interpreting
ELDERS_CROWN.flavor: I've lived through your grandfather's whole life. Now it's your turn. Take care of your people.
DESPAIR.title: Despair
DESPAIR.description: Decode with a Plan to gain Salvation. Can be used in the Random Event: All In
DESPAIR.flavor: You'll survive. Please... believe... sob, sob...
SALVATION.title: Salvation
SALVATION.description: Decode with a Plan to gain Stasis. Can be used in the Random Event: All In
SALVATION.flavor: Sleep here for a while. Once we find a cure for Oripathy, you'll wake up healthy.
STASIS.title: Stasis
STASIS.description: Can be used in the Random Event: All In
STASIS.flavor: When you wake, there will be no more suffering. Until then, I'll bear the pain.
WALL.title: Wall
WALL.description: After use, all friendly units gain 2 Buffer in the next combat
WALL.flavor: Remember how these stones are stacked. When they come for the stones, you can run.
FLAMES.title: Flames
FLAMES.description: After use, all friendly units gain 35 Attack Speed in the next combat
FLAMES.flavor: Ha, that won't happen. There's nothing here that can burn.
RELOCATION.title: Relocation
RELOCATION.description: After use, all friendly units gain 50% Dodge in the next combat
RELOCATION.flavor: Once the nobles of the Court finish their spell, take the old route. The outsiders won't find you.
OATHBREAK.title: Oathbreak
OATHBREAK.description: After use, all friendly units gain 50 Attack Speed for 2 turns after taking damage in the next combat
OATHBREAK.flavor: I've already told the people in the city to open the gates. Come in. Come kill us.
MARCH.title: March
MARCH.description: After use, all friendly units gain 40% Damage Reduction in the next combat
MARCH.flavor: Move. Faster. The road is long, and death is waiting for us.
LOST.title: Lost
LOST.description: After use, gain 1 Inspirer at the end of the next combat
LOST.flavor: Out with the old, in with the new! We can build it in another shape next time.
EXCAVATE.title: Excavate
EXCAVATE.description: After use, all friendly units gain 20% Damage Reduction in the next combat
EXCAVATE.flavor: Everyone's gone. Come back with me and see what useful things they left behind.
WITCHCRAFT.title: Witchcraft
WITCHCRAFT.description: After use, summon a Door in the next combat
WITCHCRAFT.flavor: Then our ancestor stepped through that silver door. Inside, there was everything.
INITIATE.title: Initiate
INITIATE.description: After use, draw 1 additional card each turn in the next combat
INITIATE.flavor: Back then I was studying in Kazdel, majoring in comparative literature.
CONSUME.title: Consume
CONSUME.description: After use, all friendly units gain 15% Max HP in the next combat
CONSUME.flavor: At first, we farmed. Everyone lived in the support levels, and the sun was left for the crops.
RECLAIM.title: Reclaim
RECLAIM.description: After use, all friendly units gain 30% Max HP in the next combat
RECLAIM.flavor: Later, Her Highness perfected hydroponics. Only then did we win land from the crops.
PILLAGE.title: Pillage
PILLAGE.description: After use, all friendly units gain 2 Strength in the next combat
PILLAGE.flavor: What else can we do? Take it. From sheep, from cats. They take from us too.
INVASION.title: Invasion
INVASION.description: After use, all friendly units gain 4 Strength in the next combat
INVASION.flavor: Sarkaz are supposed to 'conquer.' What does 'conquer' mean? Take it, keep it, and don't leave.
RISE_AND_FALL.title: Rise and Fall
RISE_AND_FALL.description: After use, all friendly units gain 6 Strength and 50% Max HP in the next combat
RISE_AND_FALL.flavor: I'm heading out of the city to find work.
WORDS.title: Words
WORDS.description: After use, gain 5 additional Shield in the next combat
WORDS.flavor: Register here. Where are you from? Can you speak Sarkaz? Can you write?
ASSEMBLY.title: Assembly
ASSEMBLY.description: After use, gain 10 additional Shield in the next combat
ASSEMBLY.flavor: We're not sending supplies to the front anymore? Then... will you still look after us?
CATASTROPHE_INSPIRER.title: Catastrophe Inspirer
CATASTROPHE_INSPIRER.description: After use, gain 50% more Gold dropped in the next combat
CATASTROPHE_INSPIRER.flavor: What comes must come. The people in charge think there's no need to move the city.
FURNACE.title: Furnace
FURNACE.description: After use, gain 100% more Gold dropped in the next combat
FURNACE.flavor: We rarely have to freeze. That's the greatest benefit of staying in the city.
OUTBLOOD.title: Outblood
OUTBLOOD.description: After use, all friendly units gain 15 Attack Speed in the next combat
OUTBLOOD.flavor: Don't bother remembering what their ears look like. They can always tell you're Sarkaz.
CITY_DRIVING.title: City Driving
CITY_DRIVING.description: After use, at the start of each turn in the next combat, put a random card from the discard pile into your hand
CITY_DRIVING.flavor: Remember, the maximum speed is only five kilometers per hour, or we'll spend another ten years repairing it.
MERCENARY_INSPIRER.title: Mercenary Inspirer
MERCENARY_INSPIRER.description: After use, Ability cards cost 1 less for the first 2 turns of the next combat
MERCENARY_INSPIRER.flavor: Some earn enough to feed themselves. Others earn enough to feed their families.
CIVIL_WAR.title: Civil War
CIVIL_WAR.description: After use, Ability and Skill cards cost 1 less for the first 2 turns of the next combat
CIVIL_WAR.flavor: Some say it's finally over. Others say it can never be over.
RESPITE_INSPIRER.title: Respite Inspirer
RESPITE_INSPIRER.description: After use, all friendly units gain 6 Regen in the next combat
RESPITE_INSPIRER.flavor: Rest while you can. Once the cannons start, you'll have plenty to do.
SLUMBER.title: Slumber
SLUMBER.description: After use, all friendly units recover 5% Max HP each turn for 6 turns in the next combat
SLUMBER.flavor: After a lifetime of work, I can finally sleep well. Make as much noise as you like; I won't wake up.
DEMOLITION.title: Demolition
DEMOLITION.description: After use, reduce Spines of Epoch's Max HP by 50% in the next combat
DEMOLITION.flavor: Things too large to carry away get blown apart. Even the fragments fetch a good price.
DEATHMATCH.title: Deathmatch
DEATHMATCH.description: After use, gain 100 Attack Speed and 5 Plating in the next combat
DEATHMATCH.flavor: If killing you gets me a full meal, what's so hard to understand?
MACHINE.title: Machine
MACHINE.description: After use, summon 1 Mysterious Flying Machine in the next combat
MACHINE.flavor: Press this button, fit the junk it spits out together, and you're an inventor.
INDUSTRY.title: Industry
INDUSTRY.description: After use, summon 3 Mysterious Flying Machines in the next combat
INDUSTRY.flavor: Kitchenware and instruments made by smuggled machines... Modify them, and they can all be weapons.
GRAND_WISH.title: Grand Wish
GRAND_WISH.description: After use, summon a Window in the next combat
GRAND_WISH.flavor: The ancestor who passed through the Door stood before the Window. Outside was blank, waiting for imagination to take shape.
ENVENOM.title: Envenom
ENVENOM.description: After use, all friendly units inflict 1 Necrosis whenever they deal damage in the next combat
ENVENOM.flavor: Remember what you put on the weapon. Don't trip yourself up later.
TORMENT.title: Torment
TORMENT.description: After use, enemies that are Stunned, Frozen, Shaken, or Frightened take 3 Necrosis each turn in the next combat
TORMENT.flavor: That's how those foremen are. The more you cry out, the harder they work you.
PLAN.title: Plan
PLAN.description: Can be spent during Memory Reconstruction(False to Truth), unlock new routes or alter nodes
PLAN.flavor: Keep these safe. The day they'll be useful will come.
